meta.name: cheat-seed
meta.description: 跟用户对话讨论选题——**默认一次一个**，用户主动给主题或经历，AI 围绕用户的输入深挖、提炼角度、写一份 draft。不是 AI 拿三个开放问题追用户，也不是一次给 5 个候选。触发词："找选题"/"我想做一条 X"/"最近有个想法"/"seed"/"启动种子"。可选 batch 模式：`/cheat-seed --batch 5` 走旧的 brainstorm 5 候选 + 写 5 draft 流程。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常为内容选题发愁，需要快速把想法变成可用的草稿。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle with content ideas and need quick drafts.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会与你一对一讨论选题，围绕你给的主题或经历深挖，提炼一个具体角度，然后写一份草稿。默认一次只做一个选题。
howto.when: 当你说出“找选题”、“我想做一条 X”、“最近有个想法”、“seed”或“启动种子”等触发词时，Claude 会启动这个技能。

say.text: 找选题，我想做一条关于职场内卷的。
say.note: Claude 会围绕“职场内卷”深挖你的经历和角度。

say.text: 最近有个想法，关于AI绘画的。
seed 我完全没想法，帮我想个题。
say.note: Claude 会抓取热点并给你一个建议角度。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will have a one-on-one discussion with you about topic selection, dig deep into the theme or experience you provide, refine a specific angle, and then write a draft. By default, only one topic is handled at a time.
howto.when_en: When you say trigger phrases like "find a topic", "I want to make a X", "recently had an idea", "seed", or "start seed", Claude will activate this skill.

say_en.text: Find a topic, I want to make one about workplace involution.
say_en.note: Claude will dig into your experience and angle around workplace involution.

say_en.text: Recently had an idea about AI painting.
Seed, I have no idea at all, help me think of a topic.
say_en.note: Claude will grab hot topics and give you one suggested angle.
